OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT1H` for one hour).

POLYSWARM_API_KEY.description: PolySwarm API key. Used as the TAXII Basic auth password and for the live hunting API.

POLYSWARM_ACCOUNT_NUMBER.description: PolySwarm account number. Used as the TAXII Basic auth username.

POLYSWARM_API_URL.description: PolySwarm API base URL. The connector appends the `/v3/...` paths.

POLYSWARM_FEED_COLLECTIONS.description: Comma-separated list of PolySwarm TAXII API roots to import. Allowed values: trustgroup, ransomware, freemium.

POLYSWARM_FEED_BACKFILL_DAYS.description: On the first run only, how many days of feed data to import.

POLYSWARM_FEED_INDICATOR_VALID_DAYS.description: Feed indicators are valid until import time plus this many days.

POLYSWARM_HUNTING_ENABLED.description: Import live hunting results (YARA rule matches) of the account.

POLYSWARM_HUNTING_BACKFILL_HOURS.description: On the first run only, how many hours of live hunting results to import.

POLYSWARM_HUNTING_INDICATOR_VALID_DAYS.description: Live hunting indicators are valid until import time plus this many days.

POLYSWARM_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object the connector sends.

POLYSWARM_MAX_OBJECTS_PER_RUN.description: Stop paging once this many objects were sent in a run. The next run resumes where this one stopped.
